text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi official comments on senior U.N. arms inspector Charles Duelfer's allegations on inspections on Iraqi weapons.
- Iraqi pilots ridicule chief U.N. arms inspector Rolf Ekeus' allegations that they obstruct U.N. helicopter flights in Iraq.
- Iraq takes part in Arab information ministers' meeting starting in Cairo on Wednesday.
- Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed discusses ties with Spanish foreign minister.
- Two giant irrigation projects commissioned in Basra in southern Iraq.
- Editorial condemning new U.N. resolution threatening to impose further sanctions on Iraq.
(The above except the editorial were also carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Omani state minister for foreign affairs stresses U.N. embargo on Iraq has lost its justification.
- Swiss firm to set up agricultural project in Mosul.
